notes: Scan 017 is a densely arranged autograph mathematical note. It gives finite sets E_n, an inclusion and a retraction, compatible group-action relations, the contravariant starred relations, a surjectivity condition for an inserted alpha/beta pair, iterated products defining alpha and beta, and marginal nondual versions. This is an account of the written page, not a claim that every displayed relation has been proved.

The original was viewed once for layout. Exactly two native-resolution overlapping halves were made and viewed once each: [0,0,1694,1304] and [0,1066,1694,2370]. Every line, arrow end, label, subscript, and margin block was compared with both witnesses. Seventeen first-pass crops were made and actually viewed. A combined tool response for p12–p17 was truncated before their images reached the model; the saved images were subsequently emitted in pairs and actually inspected. No additional crops, OCR, other pages/witnesses, web research, or TeX compilation were used.

Line count 54 is blockwise: independently written side-by-side text/formula rows are counted separately, with the two handwritten numerals, the small group-ens. annotation and the inserted pair included. Labels belonging to a diagram are included in its diagram row. The complete block and alteration inventory gives the reading scope.

The group glyph remains G|S at every occurrence. Its enclosing loop and interior bar favor the G-like form, but the use of permutations does not prove the symbol is S. Likewise, the inclusion glyph is consistently a closed lower loop with curved upper entry, so delta|partial is kept in place throughout. These uncertainty/ranking changes are doubts, not settled corrections against C.

The C projection reading p_{n+1} is resolved from its triangular bowl and long stem, compared with rounded cyclic rho at the foot. K remains capital throughout. A doubled upright distinguishes the finite-set E in the top and nondual lower maps. Ordinary realized E* forms are not silently changed to another alphabet.

The two upper range bounds are both n >= 2. The third starred relation has plain sigma and parenthetical id. The whole relation systems, including all group annotations and arrow labels, are included in second-reading boxes; a resolved single sign was not detached from its formula.

The projection note starts a parenthesis but its right-edge closing parenthesis is not visible. The transposition has the asymmetric written delimiters [m-1,m). Both are preserved without normalization. The source contains the phrases où, three separate défini par phrases, and a colon in the lower beta definition; H’s lexical omissions/substitutions are recorded.

The pair above (**) is an insertion attached to its arrow. Its two old indices were separately crossed and replaced. The top border of the large (**) rectangle runs through the region but does not strike the entire pair. C’s empty underbrace below the map is not supported as a mathematical brace. The group-ens. annotation earlier is a flat underbar annotation attached to E_n* only.

The inverse-cycle margin at the right breaks circulaire over lines as circu-/laire. Its following abbreviation remains doubtful as in C; inverse de is readable. The alpha-chain second label remains n-2|n-1. The lower map name is additionally m|n, ranked m from its small double-humped form, while its following pointwise formula has n. The four deleted index readings all remain doubtful because not every underlying character survives.

At the foot the factorization has rho_{m+1}, while the adjacent prose and two-case definition have rho_m in group_{m+1}. This mismatch is preserved. The final two-case line touches the sheet’s bottom edge; the visible upper strokes and surviving bases permit the written cases, without supplying further text below the sheet.
Author pagination is the dark circled 1 at the head. Grey 16 at the foot is treated separately as lighter-hand foliation. No date is written. No watermark/show-through is transcribed as source text.

Explicit H editorial transitions Le système dual : and Au bas de page, les versions non dualisées : are excluded from source text and correction counts. The 154 supplied difference rows are literal-tab parsed and individually classified. Most script-order/diagram fragments are alignment or macro artifacts, not omissions.

Refined statement 151.017.shift-composition: for E_m=[1,m], let I_m denote the inclusion written with the doubtful delta/partial glyph. Thus I_m(i)=i. The cycle called rho_m by the bottom cases satisfies rho_m(I_m(i))=i+1 for every 1 <= i <= m, with target E_{m+1}. This direct check highlights the source’s use of rho_{m+1} in the separate factorization with only a left boundary stroke; it does not license changing that index. I_m is notation used only in this check, not added to the transcription.

In scan 017 lower-left nondual maps, the alpha arrow has a clear right head. The beta line beneath has the left hook and a blunt right endpoint, with no visible head. The latter is typeset as a hooked headless shaft, correcting both witnesses; its entire formula remains in B015.

Main-reader review of the existing p05 crop leaves projection|projecteur unresolved. The first reader favored projection; the main reader found the undotted joined ending compatible with projecteur. Neither is asserted as certain. No second first-pass crop was made.

Independent audit: both upper range digits remain 2, not the second reader’s proposed 3. Stepped/gapped frames and their exterior conditions, the flat group-action underbar, and the leader of the inserted alpha/beta pair are now reproduced explicitly with text nodes. The bottom factorization has only a left boundary stroke, not a complete box. Delta/partial and the ornate group letter remain unresolved across the page; no algebraic expectation settled them. The bottom case value 1 retains its visible angled cap, upright and foot at the scan edge. The written rho_(m+1) versus rho_m mismatch remains.
